_comment: Vector from the body center of mass to the RIGHT-eye camera, in the shared body frame (+x forward, +y left, +z up), in millimetres. The left-eye camera is the sagittal mirror of this vector (y negated). Body rotation gives an offset eye an extra linear velocity Omega x offset, which is what lets the two-eye solver recover absolute translational scale.
